    <dc:description><b>A radiant escape to the lake from #1 <i>New York Times</i> bestselling author of <i>Every Summer After </i>and <i>This Summer Will Be Different</i><br>As featured in <i>People</i> &#8729; Good Morning America &#8729; <i>Cosmopolitan</i> &#8729; TODAY &#8729; E! News &#8729; Buzzfeed &#8729; <i>Us Weekly</i> &#8729; <i>The New York Post</i> &#8729; SheReads &#8729; and more!<br></b><br><b><i>I never anticipated Charlie Florek.<br></i></b><br>Good things happen at the lake. That&rsquo;s what Alice&rsquo;s grandmother says, and it&rsquo;s true. Alice spent just one summer there at a cottage with Nan when she was seventeen&mdash;it&rsquo;s where she took that photo, the one of three grinning teenagers in a yellow speedboat, the image that changed her life.<br>Now Alice lives behind a lens. As a photographer, she&rsquo;s most comfortable on the sidelines, letting other people shine. Lately though, she&rsquo;s been itching for something more, and when Nan falls and breaks her hip,...</dc:description>
